facts.fact: Masvingo's Minister of State for Provincial Affairs said 104 Starlink kits were distributed to schools, clinics and local authorities in the province in the first and second quarters of 2026, improving internet connectivity; the article does not say how many went to local authorities or whether they are activated.

The Masvingo provincial minister said the 104 Starlink kits given to schools, clinics and local authorities in the first half of 2026 improved internet connectivity and access to digital services; no system that council staff work in over them is named.

The 104 Starlink kits distributed in Masvingo Province in the first half of 2026 are given as one total for schools, clinics and local authorities, per the provincial minister; the number of local authorities receiving one is not stated, and no national figure is given.
